# Lucide UI icons

Source: <https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons>
Retrieved: 2026-09-17. The SVG geometry is copied from the upstream files.

These outline icons match the selected Reader reference's rounded, 2px-stroke
controls. They are served locally and rendered as masks using the current text
color; no icon package or external request is required at runtime.

The adjacent LICENSE preserves Lucide's ISC notice and the Feather-derived
icons' MIT notice. Provider marks remain in the existing provider icon module.
